de: In Japan, a man dressed as a woman and entered the women’s bathing complex with hot springs.

de: Albania reported that riots have resumed in Tirana, in which protesters throw incendiary bottles at police.

de: Vucic said he would not allow Serbia to become part of EU plans to prepare for a conflict with Russia.
